items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...taken with Q and Justin and died in one of the units over at Camp A.

ctx.x: I'll die if you have a hand. Is it three-course legal when I'm home? Is it $100 when I'm home? Well, the scene is a good hold of $20. You're here, baby, where you been so long? Oh, Lord, you'll show me where you been so long. Now, is it? Is it good, brother? There's a man ain't nothing but a man. People I'll never see, beat me down. Lord, I'll die if you have a hand. Lord, Lord, I'll die if you have a hand. Show her why, boy, show her. Boy, this song's getting so hot, I don't know what to do. Well, let's get it…

He died now. Yes, sir. He was a very swell fellow. He was always practically wanting to participate in anything that the other inmates would do beneficial to the prison. In August 11, 59, before they went on and taken with Q and Justin and died in one of the units over at Camp A. You know, he was waiting for a return in September from Mr. Austin. He was supposed to come back. He was on a tour. So, Mr. Austin, the professor, used to come up here. And he would say he was going to make some more records and let them…
Now, you say he was quite young?
